name: Add Button Component Variants and Sizes
description: Extend Button component with proper variant and size support, plus IconButton
prompt: Extend the Button component in src/components/Button.js to support all required variants (primary, secondary, danger, ghost) and sizes (sm, md, lg). Add disabled state styling. Implement an IconButton component that renders an icon with optional label. Add proper CSS class naming.
acceptance: Button supports variants: primary, secondary, danger, ghost
Button supports sizes: sm, md, lg
IconButton renders icon with optional label
expectedInvariants: All variants produce correct CSS classes
